executor_summary: Added a MainActivity invitation onboarding regression that verifies signed-in invite acceptance with a real conversationId launches ChatActivity with the expected contact and conversation extras.
reviewer_summary: Needs fix for commit 916cafeaa200b9b7c4feb3b9d0f8fb10d3505bd3: the new MainActivity invitation regression bypasses the STARTED lifecycle collector, so it does not cover the signed-in onboarding path it claims to protect.
review_status_reason: Needs fix for commit 916cafeaa200b9b7c4feb3b9d0f8fb10d3505bd3: MainActivity invitation onboarding coverage invokes the private handler directly on a CREATED activity instead of exercising the repeatOnLifecycle(STARTED) path.
feedback: Replace the reflective CREATED-state test with a lifecycle-driven MainActivity regression that starts the activity and proves the queued invitation intent reaches chat launch through the STARTED uiState collector.
next_action: Replace the reflective CREATED-state test with a STARTED/RESUMED MainActivity regression that drives the queued invitation intent through the real uiState collector and asserts the chat launch extras.
